analysis.description: This paper introduces Spatially Structured Recurrent Modules (S2RMs), which focus on learning dynamic models capable of exploiting both modular and spatiotemporal structures. It evaluates these modules for video prediction from cropped frames, multi-agent world modeling in Starcraft2, and a multi-agent grid-world environment. The results demonstrate robustness to the number of available views and the ability to generalize to new tasks without additional training, comparing favorably against strong baselines.
